CSeq: The CSeq field of a request MUST be echoed in the response.
The CSeq field of a request MUST be incremented for each request sent by the client.
CSeq: A sequence number and method name.
A CSeq header field in a request contains the request method and a decimal sequence number.
Call-ID: Call-ID: A globally unique identifier for this call.
The Call-ID header field acts as a unique identifier to group together a series of messages.
From: From: The logical identity of the initiator of the request.
The From header field indicates the logical identity of the initiator of the request.
Max-Forwards: Max-Forwards: Limits the number of hops a request can take.
The Max-Forwards header field must be used with any SIP request method.
To: To: The logical recipient of the request.
The To header field specifies the logical recipient of the request.
Via: Via: The transport protocol used to send the request and the client's address.
The Via header field indicates the transport used for the transaction and identifies the location where the response is to be sent.
